2. End-to-End Enterprise Skill Supply Chain, Outcome Convergence & Cron Observability Architecture
Four-Pillar Governance: Vetted Skill Exchange ➔ 147 Dual-Manifest Skills ➔ Outcome-Convergent Workflows ➔ Cronalytics
Pillar A: Outcome Convergence (claude-code-workflows)
• Anti-Rabbit-Hole Guard: Solves the #1 failure mode of deep
codebase exploration—getting distracted by tangential bugs
• Approved-Outcome Anchor: Keeps design and implementation
strictly aligned with the user-approved specification
• Side-Quest Deferral: Logs discovered tangential issues
separately instead of derailing the primary PR
• Community Scale: ★719 stars, 108 forks, 6 languages (MIT)
✓ Prevents scope creep & bloated unreviewable agent PRs
Pillar B: 147 Cross-Harness Skills (secondsky/claude-skills)
• Dual Native Marketplaces: Ships both `.claude-plugin/` and
`.codex-plugin/` manifests in one repository (`v3.9.0`)
• 147 Production Skills: Deep coverage for Cloudflare Workers,
React, Tailwind v4, modern full-stack & AI integrations
• Universal Harness Bridge: Native in Claude Code, Codex CLI
& ZCode; portable to Cursor & Windsurf via `skills.sh`
• License: Permissive MIT License
✓ Write once, install natively in both Claude Code & Codex CLI
Pillar C: Security-Reviewed Catalog (agentskillexchange)
• Massive Curated Index: 3,272 published skills organized
across 15 industry collections and 17 functional categories
• Security Verification Pipeline: 2,678 skills explicitly
security-reviewed (`verification/`) against prompt injection
• Multi-Ecosystem Compatibility: OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex,
GitHub Copilot, Gemini CLI, Cursor, MCP & LangChain
• License: Permissive MIT License
✓ Mitigates supply-chain risk from unvetted community skills
Pillar D: Scheduled Agent Telemetry (8bit64k/cronalytics)
• Purpose-Built for Hermes Agent: Dedicated cron analytics
and observability dashboard (`v1.1.0`, Python, MIT)
• Automation Health Visibility: Monitors recurring nightly
and hourly agent jobs, execution durations & failure rates
• Schedule Drift & Error Triage: Surfaces missed triggers,
stalled runs & token/tool anomalies in one web view
• CI Verified: Automated GitHub Actions test suite
✓ Gives SREs full visibility into unattended cron agents
